scope: Root form data ownership, ordinary controls, restart, stale references and error cleanup. Shared-object case uses a read-only bound field and its existing Use-protected business handler; it does not establish arbitrary shared-object editor support. Generated wrappers and explicit child registrations still require private plain local data.

retainedFindings: Before the ownership fix, an entity root raised a 4D error when AXB_Form assigned axbView.

Native startup focus can arrive after an AX request is queued. A focus-only transition from no control to the exact unchanged target is now accepted before dispatch. Values, selection, other focus, scope and expiry remain checked. The Session regression failed before the fix.
A compiled button request during initial focus arriving on another control correctly rejects. The fixture now waits for the first published native focus before testing business actions.
The fixture waits for text-completion receipts before pressing the next button; observing the last character does not by itself mean the action slot is available.
